reasoning.note: With thinking on, MiMo uses its own temperature and top-p. Turning thinking off is what makes them adjustable (still to be confirmed through OpenRouter).

max_tokens.why: Evening-Truth suggests leaving 5K+ room while the prompt asks for replies under 500 tokens.

temperature.why: Fixed at 1 while thinking; 0 to 1.5 with thinking off.

notes.text: Slow-burn relationships with believable pushback: characters can care, resist and stay flawed; relationships can regress.
Proactive storytelling: characters start events instead of waiting.
Counterexample: spatial mistakes, fourth-wall leaks and worse performance reported; check the route before blaming taste.

probes: Should affection make them easier to deal with, or should some of their difficult habits remain?

trial.compare: Lean baseline vs a concise rule block, adding one repair at a time
trial.limit: Earlier research supports trying lean wording; no measured optimum
trial.source: research cookbook, section 6 (initial experiments, not rankings)

card.best_for: Slow burn with friction: flawed characters who push back, relationships that can go backwards, characters who start things.
card.watch_out: Occasional slips in physical details or stepping out of the story.
